blocks.text: BANGA, South Cotabato — Social Welfare Secretary Rex Gatchalian arrived here Sunday to check on victims and families affected by the deadly shooting at Banga National High School (BNHS). Gatchalian, who arrived shortly after 11 a.m., visited the victims, their parents and teachers affected by the Sept. 18 shooting. READ: Campus shooter ‘planned attack, warned classmates’ Aside from checking on their condition, his visit aims to ensure that the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) continues to provide assistance and social services to those affected by the tragedy.
